use_case_and_requirements: Workloads: low-latency clinical decision support (avg 150-250ms p95), batch embedding generation for indexing historical records, document summarization for clinician notes
Throughput target: sustained 30 reqs/sec for inference path with bursts to 120 reqs/sec during clinic hours
Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for short responses; p99 target TBD
Cost sensitivity: medium-high — prefers reserved capacity but must balance with data residency premium
Model preferences: tuned open LLMs (>=13B) with optional quantized variants; fallbacks to smaller model for degraded capacity
Routing/fallback: regional routing to EU-only capacity; automatic fallback to dedicate smaller model if primary unavailable
Data residency: EU-only processing and logging retention controls; provenance and audit trail required for all inference calls
KMS: must bring-your-own-key (AWS KMS) with cross-account grants; HSM optional for key custody
Audit logging: raw audit logs forwarded to Splunk/SIEM with 1 year retention for compliance
Identity: SSO/SAML required; role-based access control and token-level permissions
architecture_fit_notes: Preferred topology: customer VPC with private subnets hosting inference nodes; Redwood control plane must either be in a customer-managed VPC endpoint or run as an approved peered service in eu-west-1
Inbound/outbound: no public inbound allowed; outbound egress via NAT gateway for OS updates; control-plane comms to Redwood over private endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) or VPN
Networking: VPC endpoints for S3 and ECR; S3 bucketing in EU for model artifacts and KV caches
KMS integration: per-tenant CMKs (customer-managed) with restricted grants to Redwood deployment account; require example grant templates
Audit logging: application-level token tracing plus VPC flow logs; logs delivered to customer SIEM via Kinesis/Firehose
Regions: initial rollout in eu-west-1 (Ireland); DR region eu-central-1 considered; avoid us/east regions for PHI
On-prem option: potential air-gapped inference nodes for most-sensitive datasets; prefer hybrid model (control plane in VPC + compute on prem behind NAT)
POC footprint requested: 2 x A10G or equivalent GPUs in private subnets, 3-tier monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana + Splunk forwarder)
security_review_status: Questionnaire submitted 2026-02-08. InfoSec provided follow-ups on 2026-02-22 (requested KMS grant template, SSAE/SOC evidence). Legal awaiting subprocessor clause update.
